A pack hunter of the northern forests that howls at the moon

A tiny social insect that forms colonies and carries leaves underground

Hairy tree-swinging primate with no tail, a relative of gorillas and chimps

Clear liquid that falls as rain and fills rivers, lakes and oceans
Something worn on the head to keep warm in winter
